neighbours.label: US names that are also places: ' Washington', ' Vancouver', ' State' of Penn State (gate-closed echo regime)
fire: They toured George Washington's farm in Virginia.

The ferry goes to Vancouver every morning.

notes: Card: ' Washington' 11, ' State' 5, ' Vancouver' 2. Probes: ' Washington' 0.88, ' Vancouver' 0.54, ' State' 0.37, ' Houston' 0.22; Mount Everest 0.04, Harvard 0.11. The - pole has Christchurch and Tashkent, so this may be about place names more widely.
